connector.name: MCP by sladd.no
connector.registryDescription: Detect and redact Norwegian PII (fodselsnummer, names, health data) in text and PDFs.
connector.summary: Hosted at sladd.no over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace no.sladd, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <Sladd API key>, e.g. 'Bearer sk_sladd_...'. Issued at https://sladd.no/api

env.name: SLADD_API_KEY
env.description: Sladd API key (sk_sladd_...). Issued at https://sladd.no/api

env.name: SLADD_API_BASE
env.description: Override the Sladd API base URL. Default: https://sladd.no
